_comment: Scripted-input demo: click-select the Spearmen (uid 0, spawned at ~120,232.5 on seed 12345), then right-drag a flank line to deploy them. Driven through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd. Coordinates are world-space; ticks are physics ticks (60/s).

path_crossing.reason: The clip deliberately films a large formation reshape at the new pitch identity; the block marches onto the dragged line and its men's routes cross while the grid re-deals. Measured 2026-11-10 on aef5b476 on seeds 0 to 4 (the sim has no RNG draw here, so all five seeds read alike): on the clip's own declared ticks path_crossing reads 0.343 against the 0.15 threshold, so the exemption is live there; on dense 2-tick FULL dumps over ticks 2 to 700 it reads 0 on every seed, so it reads STALE there. Kept because the own-tick scan, which is what CI and tools/check.sh demo_defects run, still fires.
